trust_decision.summary: Whether a bind carrying a user DN and an empty-or-null password is refused before it is placed in the JNDI SECURITY_PRINCIPAL/SECURITY_CREDENTIALS pair; decided per DirContextAuthenticationStrategy (synchronous Hashtable setup for SIMPLE/DIGEST-MD5, post-creation LdapContext.addToEnvironment for TLS).

landing_point.why: The summary reads as a generic 'empty password authentication bypass'; SimpleDirContextAuthenticationStrategy is the default strategy installed by AbstractContextSource, so it is the first place an engineer looks and it is where the reported LdapTemplate.authenticate("", "") success originates.

fix_sites.entry_point: ContextSource.getContext(String principal, String credentials) / getReadOnlyContext() / LdapTemplate.authenticate(...) with the default strategy
fix_sites.module_kind: core library, default SIMPLE strategy (env Hashtable built before context creation)

fix_sites.entry_point: Same ContextSource/LdapTemplate/LdapClient entry points when a DigestMd5DirContextAuthenticationStrategy is wired via setAuthenticationStrategy or <ldap:context-source authentication-strategy-ref>
fix_sites.module_kind: core library, SASL DIGEST-MD5 strategy (env Hashtable built before context creation)

fix_sites.entry_point: Same entry points when a TLS strategy is configured; reached via AbstractTlsDirContextAuthenticationStrategy.processContextAfterCreation after TLS negotiation
fix_sites.module_kind: core library, TLS strategy whose sink is a lower-level API (LdapContext.addToEnvironment on a live context) in a protected hook, not setupEnvironment

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The odm tools are standalone schema code-generation/inspection CLIs that assemble a raw JNDI Hashtable and never touch DirContextAuthenticationStrategy, so a solver can argue the advisory only covers the strategies; SchemaViewer also defaults username/password to "" so its bind looks intentionally anonymous.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: EXTERNAL SASL authentication binds with a client certificate and legitimately carries no password, so the check must not be added to the shared AbstractTlsDirContextAuthenticationStrategy.processContextAfterCreation; likewise an anonymous context (userDn "", password "") must keep binding, which AbstractContextSource.afterPropertiesSet explicitly permits for a blank configured password.

O6_input_shapes: userDn "" + password "" (must remain allowed: anonymous simple bind)

O8_uncovered_routes.route: SchemaToJava CLI: -u <dn> without -p leaves SECURITY_CREDENTIALS unset next to SECURITY_PRINCIPAL and binds with new InitialDirContext(env), the exact empty-credential shape; no guard was added.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Developer code-generation CLI in another module, not the authentication strategy API the advisory names; also needs a live LDAP server to exercise.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: different module (odm) and package (org.springframework.ldap.odm.tools) from core/.../core/support

O8_uncovered_routes.route: SchemaViewer CLI: username and password both default to "" and are always put into the env, so -u <dn> without -p binds with a DN and an empty credential; no guard was added.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Same: an operator-run schema inspection tool, not a library authentication path; the empty defaults look deliberate for anonymous reads.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: different module (odm) and package (org.springframework.ldap.odm.tools) from core/.../core/support

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Base-environment route: setBaseEnvironmentProperties can carry SECURITY_PRINCIPAL plus an empty SECURITY_CREDENTIALS and getReadOnlyContext() passes that Hashtable straight to createContext when anonymousReadOnly is set, never calling the authentication strategy.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: These are raw JNDI properties supplied by the application and documented as an arbitrary custom-environment escape hatch, so the library can plausibly say it does not interpret them.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same package as the landing point, but a different source of the env (caller-supplied properties vs. the AuthenticationSource)

O8b_injection_room.sibling: An additional DirContextAuthenticationStrategy (e.g. CRAM-MD5, GSSAPI or a proxy-auth strategy) that copies the same three env.put lines and would be missed by a fix written only against the two strategies the report names.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The interface has exactly two hooks and the two existing env-building strategies are near-identical templates, so a maintainer adding a mechanism copies one of them; nothing in the interface makes the empty-password rule explicit.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A third TLS authentication strategy overriding applyAuthentication, or a variant that sets credentials in processContextAfterCreation, sharing the post-creation LdapContext sink with DefaultTlsDirContextAuthenticationStrategy.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The abstract class already centralises TLS negotiation and calls the protected applyAuthentication hook, so adding a sibling there is the natural extension point and it sits one level below the method the fix guards.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A shared env-building helper used by both ODM CLI tools, with the empty-credential rejection inside it, next to the duplicated raw JNDI block.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Both tools duplicate the same provider-url/principal/credentials block; a maintainer who noticed the CVE while touching a tool would naturally factor and guard that block.

O9_family: CWE-287 improper authentication (LDAP simple bind accepts a DN with an empty password as an unauthenticated bind); authentication bypass

O10_build.toolchain: Gradle wrapper (gradlew, gradle/wrapper) with Spring's io.spring.convention plugins; JDK 25 per .sdkmanrc; multi-module (core, dependencies, test-support, ldif/ldif-core, odm, test/integration-tests*)
O10_build.project_tests: core has mock-based unit tests for this area: LdapTemplateTests, DefaultLdapClientTests, LdapContextSourceTests, SimpleDirContextAuthenticationStrategyTests, DefaultTlsDirContextAuthenticationStrategyTests; test-support ships an in-process UnboundID EmbeddedLdapServerFactoryBean and core already depends on unboundid-ldapsdk (core/build.gradle:40), so real bind behaviour can be exercised without an external server. test/integration-tests* (LdapTemplateAuthenticationITests, DefaultLdapClientAuthenticationITests) need an external OpenLDAP/AD server.

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Add the check once in the shared abstract TLS hook (or once in AbstractContextSource.setupAuthenticatedEnvironment) so a single edit appears to cover every strategy, which breaks EXTERNAL certificate auth or leaves the per-strategy contract unguarded.
